description:
[EUDAMED Basic UDI-DI & UDI-DI / PI GS1 modulo-10 barcode validator. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits Basic UDI-DI and UDI-DI / UDI-PI structures under Regulation (EU) 2017/745 Article 27 and Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1239, verifying GS1 GTIN-14 modulo-10 check digits and production identifiers.
Usage: Pass agency, Basic UDI-DI, and UDI-DI/PI strings to audit EUDAMED registration readiness and format human-readable text.
Returns: JSON object with { issuingAgency: string, basicUdiDi: string, isBasicUdiDiValid: boolean, udiDi: string, isUdiDiValid: boolean, udiDiCheckDigitCalculated: number, udiPiElementsPresent: array, eudamedRegistrationReady: boolean, statutoryVerdict: string, formattedHumanReadableRepresentation: string }.

basicUdiDi.description: Basic UDI-DI (Model identifier registered in EUDAMED)

issuingAgency.description: Designated UDI issuing agency ex Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/939

udiDi.description: UDI-DI static device identifier (e.g. 14-digit GTIN for GS1)

name: eudamed_udi_di_validator
